mods.name: Healing Mod: Rebooted
mods.description: Healing Mod: Rebooted is a complete reimagining of the original Healing Mod v1.3.0, rebuilt from the ground up for Minecraft 1.21 using NeoForge. Whether you're battling mobs, surviving with friends, or just need a quick recovery, this mod adds a new layer of survival depth with healing items, visual effects, and balanced recovery mechanics.

releases.notes:
# What's New?
* Heal Man Now transforms into Damage Man if Stays in Nether for too long
* King Damage Man now able getting summoned by tier 4 damage fluid storage
* King Heal Man Spawn Egg now Added to the Creative List 
* Fixed a Mispelled massage from Tier 4 Fluid Storages To "insufficient" instead "insufficent"
* now any tiers of Damage fluid storage now functional to increase your strength when powered
* Increased Maximal fluid capacity for Tier 4 Damage Fluid Storage from 15000 to 30000
* Fixed a Advancement "Thore of Shars" Not Obtainable from Killing King Damage Man
